story: Cao Cao died early in 220, still officially a Han minister, though he held the title King of Wei. His son Cao Pi inherited his titles and army.

Within months Cao Pi's supporters staged a careful ritual. Officials presented omens and petitions, and Emperor Xian of Han offered to step down. Cao Pi politely refused several times, as custom required, and then accepted. In the winter of 220 he took the throne as emperor of Wei, ending a dynasty that had lasted, with one break, for over four centuries. The former emperor was given the title Duke of Shanyang and lived on quietly until 234. Cao Pi made Luoyang his capital.
story_zh: 220年初，曹操去世。他生前虽已封为魏王，名义上仍是汉朝的臣子。其子曹丕继承了他的爵位和军队。
几个月后，曹丕的支持者精心安排了一场禅让：百官呈上各种祥瑞和劝进表，汉献帝表示愿意让位。曹丕按照惯例再三推辞，最后才接受。220年冬，曹丕即皇帝位，国号魏，绵延四百多年的汉朝至此终结。献帝被封为山阳公，平静地活到234年。曹丕定都洛阳。
cao-pi.why: It formally ended the Han and set the pattern of "abdication" that later usurpers copied for centuries.
cao-pi.why_zh: 它正式结束了汉朝，此后几百年的篡位者都仿照这种“禅让”模式。

story: When news reached Chengdu that Cao Pi had ended the Han, a rumor also spread that Emperor Xian had been killed. Liu Bei, who claimed descent from a Han prince, held mourning rites for him.

In 221 his officials urged him to take the throne so that the Han would not die out. He was crowned in Chengdu and named his state Han; historians call it Shu Han, after the old name of Sichuan. Zhuge Liang became chancellor. Liu Bei now ruled Yi Province, which he had taken from Liu Zhang in 214, and Hanzhong. But he had lost Jing Province to Wu, and his first act as emperor was to plan a war to win it back.
story_zh: 曹丕代汉的消息传到成都，同时传言汉献帝已经遇害。自称汉室后裔的刘备为献帝发丧。
221年，群臣劝刘备即位，以延续汉朝的国祚。刘备在成都称帝，国号仍为汉，史称蜀汉。诸葛亮出任丞相。此时刘备据有214年从刘璋手中夺得的益州以及汉中，但荆州已被东吴夺走。他称帝后的第一件大事，就是筹划东征夺回荆州。
shu-han.why: It made three rival emperors in China and gave Shu its claim to be the true heir of the Han.
shu-han.why_zh: 从此中国出现三位皇帝并立，蜀汉也以汉朝正统继承者自居。

story: Liu Bei wanted revenge for Guan Yu and to win back Jing Province. Just before the campaign, his sworn brother Zhang Fei was murdered by his own officers. In 221 Liu Bei led his army down the Yangtze gorges into Wu territory.

Sun Quan gave command to the young general Lu Xun, whom older officers doubted. Lu Xun refused to fight for months and let Liu Bei string his camps along hundreds of li of forested valleys. In the summer heat of 222 he attacked with fire. The wooden stockades burned one after another, and the Shu army was destroyed. Liu Bei fled to Baidicheng, where he fell ill and died the following year.
story_zh: 刘备要为关羽报仇，夺回荆州。出征前夕，他的结义兄弟张飞被部下杀害。221年，刘备率大军顺长江三峡东下，攻入吴境。
孙权任命年轻的陆逊为统帅，许多老将并不服气。陆逊坚守数月不出战，任由刘备把营寨沿山谷连绵扎下数百里。222年盛夏，陆逊下令火攻，木栅营寨接连起火，蜀军全线崩溃。刘备退到白帝城，一病不起，次年去世。
yiling.why: Shu lost much of its army, and Zhuge Liang then restored the alliance with Wu against Wei.
yiling.why_zh: 蜀汉精锐损失殆尽，诸葛亮此后重新与东吴结盟，共同对抗曹魏。

story: From 228 Zhuge Liang led five northern campaigns against Wei, hoping to take the Wei River valley and restore the Han. Shu was much smaller than Wei, and supplying armies over the Qinling mountains was very hard. He designed "wooden oxen" to carry grain.

In 234 he advanced to the Wuzhang Plains, south of the Wei River, and set his soldiers farming to stay longer. The Wei commander Sima Yi refused to give battle, even when Zhuge sent him women's clothing as an insult. After more than a hundred days, Zhuge Liang fell ill and died in camp, aged 53. The Shu army withdrew in good order, and Sima Yi did not dare to pursue.
story_zh: 从228年起，诸葛亮先后五次北伐曹魏，希望夺取渭水流域，兴复汉室。蜀汉国力远不如魏，翻越秦岭运送粮草尤其艰难，他为此设计了“木牛流马”。
234年，诸葛亮进军渭水南岸的五丈原，并让士兵屯田，作长期打算。魏军统帅司马懿坚守不战，诸葛亮送去女人的衣服羞辱他，他也不为所动。相持一百多天后，诸葛亮病逝军中，年仅五十四岁。蜀军从容撤退，司马懿不敢追击，留下“死诸葛走生仲达”的说法。
wuzhang.why: His death ended Shu's serious attempts to conquer Wei, and he became the model of the loyal, wise minister.
wuzhang.why_zh: 他的去世标志着蜀汉北伐中原的努力基本结束，他本人也成为忠诚贤相的典范。

story: By 263 Shu was exhausted by Jiang Wei's repeated campaigns, and the court was dominated by the eunuch Huang Hao. The Wei regent Sima Zhao sent three armies. Zhong Hui led the main force but was held up by Jiang Wei at the Jiange pass.

Deng Ai took a bold gamble. He led his men for hundreds of li through roadless mountains along the Yinping route, building bridges and wrapping himself in felt to roll down cliffs. He came out at Jiangyou, defeated Zhuge Liang's son Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu, and approached Chengdu. The emperor Liu Shan surrendered without a fight. He was taken to Luoyang and lived out his life in comfort.
story_zh: 到263年，蜀汉因姜维连年北伐而国力疲惫，朝中又有宦官黄皓弄权。魏国权臣司马昭派三路大军伐蜀，钟会率主力，却被姜维挡在剑阁。
邓艾决定冒险。他率军从阴平小道穿越七百多里无人山地，凿山开路、架设栈道，遇到绝壁就裹着毛毡滚下去。魏军突然出现在江油，又在绵竹击败诸葛亮之子诸葛瞻，直逼成都。后主刘禅不战而降，被迁往洛阳，安享余生。
wei-shu.why: It ended the Three Kingdoms balance and set up the Sima family to seize the throne and later conquer Wu.
wei-shu.why_zh: 三国鼎立的局面由此打破，为司马氏篡魏和日后灭吴铺平了道路。

story: Under the Han, officials were chosen through recommendations of the "filial and incorruptible." The wars of the late Han scattered families and made that system hard to run. In 220 Cao Pi's minister Chen Qun proposed a new method.

In each commandery and province an official called the Impartial and Just, usually a respected local man serving at court, graded candidates into nine ranks based on their family background, character and talent. The ranks decided where a man could start his career. At first it helped Wei find capable people. But the assessors came from great families and favored their own kind, and family status soon outweighed merit. Critics said the top ranks held no poor families and the bottom ranks no great ones.
story_zh: 汉代选官依靠地方推举“孝廉”。汉末战乱使人口流散，这套办法难以为继。220年，曹丕采纳尚书陈群的建议，推行新制度。
朝廷在各郡、州设立中正官，一般由在朝任职、德高望重的本地人担任，根据家世、品德和才能把士人评为九等，作为授官的依据。起初这一制度帮助魏国选拔了不少人才，但中正官多出身大族，偏袒同类，家世很快压倒了才能。后人批评说“上品无寒门，下品无势族”。
nine-rank-system.why: It became the main way of choosing officials until the Sui, and it entrenched the great aristocratic families of the period.
nine-rank-system.why_zh: 九品中正制一直沿用到隋朝，成为门阀士族垄断仕途的制度基础。

people.name: Chen Qun
people.role_zh: 设计该制度的曹魏大臣

story: After Liu Bei's death in 223, local leaders in Nanzhong, the far south of Shu, revolted, encouraged by Wu. Yong Kai, Gao Ding and Zhu Bao seized several commanderies.

In 225 Zhuge Liang led armies south by three routes. The rebel leaders were soon killed or fell out among themselves. Meng Huo, a leader respected by both Han and local peoples, took over. According to a famous story in the later history Han Jin Chunqiu, Zhuge captured and released him seven times until he promised never to rebel again. Zhuge then left local chiefs in charge rather than posting Han officials and large garrisons, and he took tribute in cattle, horses and metals for his northern wars.
story_zh: 223年刘备去世后，蜀汉南部的南中地区在东吴的煽动下发生叛乱，雍闿、高定、朱褒等人占据多个郡。
225年，诸葛亮兵分三路南征。叛军首领很快或被杀，或自相残杀。深受汉人和当地各族敬重的孟获接过了领导权。据《汉晋春秋》记载，诸葛亮七擒七纵孟获，最终使他心服，发誓不再反叛。平定之后，诸葛亮任用当地首领治理，不多派汉官和驻军，并从南中征收耕牛、战马和金属，供应北伐。
southern-campaign.why: It secured Shu's southern rear and supplied resources for the northern campaigns.
southern-campaign.why_zh: 南征稳定了蜀汉的后方，为北伐提供了物资。

story: Sun Quan had inherited the lands south of the Yangtze from his brother Sun Ce in 200. For years he balanced between his neighbors. In 221 he even accepted the title King of Wu from Cao Pi, to keep Wei quiet while he fought Liu Bei.

Once Wei and Shu were both busy elsewhere, he felt secure enough to rule in his own name. In 229 he declared himself emperor at Wuchang, and in the autumn moved his capital to Jianye. Shu, which still needed Wu as an ally, accepted this, and the two states agreed how they would split Wei if they conquered it. Sun Quan ruled until 252, longer than any other ruler of the period.
story_zh: 200年，孙权从兄长孙策手中继承了江东。他多年来周旋于强邻之间，221年甚至接受曹丕所封的吴王称号，以稳住魏国，专心对付刘备。
等到魏、蜀都无暇他顾，他便放心以自己的名义称帝。229年，孙权在武昌称帝，同年秋迁都建业。仍需东吴作盟友的蜀汉承认了这一点，两国还约定灭魏后如何瓜分其土地。孙权在位直到252年，是三国君主中统治时间最长的一位。
sun-quan-emperor.why: It completed the Three Kingdoms, and Jianye (Nanjing) began its long role as the capital of the south.
sun-quan-emperor.why_zh: 三国鼎立至此完全形成，建业（南京）也从此开始了作为南方都城的漫长历史。

story: Himiko was a queen who, according to Chinese records, ruled a league of about thirty small states in Wa, or Japan. The Records of the Three Kingdoms say she was unmarried, practiced magic, and was rarely seen, with her brother helping her rule.

In 239, just after Wei took Liaodong, her envoys reached the Wei commandery of Daifang in Korea and went on to Luoyang. The Wei court gave her the title "Ruler of Wa, Friend of Wei," a gold seal, silk and a hundred bronze mirrors. Her kingdom is called Yamatai, and whether it lay in Kyushu or the Kinai region is still debated. She died around 248. Her name does not appear in early Japanese chronicles.
story_zh: 据中国史书记载，卑弥呼是倭国（日本）约三十个小国联盟的女王。《三国志·魏书·东夷传》说她终身未婚，善用巫术，很少露面，由她的弟弟协助治理国家。
239年，魏刚平定辽东，卑弥呼的使者就来到朝鲜半岛的带方郡，又转赴洛阳。魏朝封她为“亲魏倭王”，赐给金印、丝织品和铜镜百枚。她的国家称为邪马台国，究竟位于九州还是近畿，至今仍有争论。卑弥呼约在248年去世，日本早期的史书中并没有出现她的名字。
himiko-envoy.why: The Chinese account is the main written source for Japan in the third century.
himiko-envoy.why_zh: 这段记载是研究三世纪日本历史最主要的文字资料。

story: When Emperor Ming of Wei died in 239, his eight-year-old son Cao Fang came to the throne with two regents: the royal kinsman Cao Shuang and the veteran general Sima Yi. Cao Shuang pushed Sima aside, and Sima pretended to be old and ill.

In early 249 Cao Shuang and his brothers left Luoyang with the emperor to visit the Gaoping tomb of Emperor Ming. Sima Yi at once closed the city gates, took over the guards and sent a memorial accusing Cao Shuang of crimes. He promised Cao that he would only lose his offices. Cao surrendered, but days later he and his family and allies were executed with their relatives to the third degree.
story_zh: 239年魏明帝去世，八岁的曹芳即位，由宗室曹爽和老将司马懿共同辅政。曹爽排挤司马懿，司马懿便装作年老多病。
249年初，曹爽兄弟陪同皇帝出城祭扫明帝的高平陵。司马懿立即关闭洛阳城门，接管禁军，并上表弹劾曹爽。他承诺曹爽只要交出兵权就可保全爵位。曹爽投降，但几天后便与家族及党羽一同被诛灭三族。
gaoping-tombs.why: From this point the Sima family were the real rulers of Wei, and Sima Yi's grandson founded the Jin in 266.
gaoping-tombs.why_zh: 此后司马氏成为魏国的实际统治者，司马懿之孙司马炎于266年建立晋朝。

story: The Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove were a circle of scholars, including Ji Kang, Ruan Ji and Shan Tao, who met to drink, talk and play music. They rejected rigid Confucian rules and favored Daoist ideas of naturalness, partly as a protest against the Sima family's rise.

Ji Kang, a gifted poet and qin player married into the Cao clan, refused to serve the Simas. When his friend Shan Tao recommended him for a post, Ji wrote a famous letter breaking off their friendship. In about 262 he was drawn into a friend's lawsuit, and the official Zhong Hui, whom he had snubbed, urged his death. Three thousand students petitioned for his life in vain. Before his execution he calmly played the tune Guangling San.
story_zh: 竹林七贤是嵇康、阮籍、山涛等七位名士，他们常在竹林中饮酒、清谈、弹琴，蔑视繁琐的儒家礼教，崇尚老庄的自然之道，这在一定程度上也是对司马氏专权的消极抗议。
嵇康诗文和琴艺都很出色，又是曹氏宗室的女婿，拒绝为司马氏效力。山涛推荐他做官，他写下著名的《与山巨源绝交书》。约262年，他因好友的官司受牵连，曾被他冷落的钟会趁机进谗，主张处死他。三千太学生请愿求情也没有用。临刑前，嵇康从容弹奏了一曲《广陵散》。
ji-kang.why: The Seven Sages became symbols of intellectual freedom and of the "Wei-Jin spirit" admired by later poets and painters.
ji-kang.why_zh: 竹林七贤成为思想自由的象征，所代表的“魏晋风度”深受后世文人画家推崇。

people.name: Ruan Ji
people.role: Poet, one of the Seven Sages

people.name: Shan Tao
people.role: Official, one of the Seven Sages

quote.en: The Guangling San dies with me today!
quote.from: Book of Jin 晋书·嵇康传

story: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art was a Han-era collection of 246 practical problems, from measuring fields to dividing taxes. It gave methods and answers, but rarely explained why the methods worked.

In 263 Liu Hui, about whom little else is known, wrote a commentary that supplied proofs and reasoning. To find the value of pi, he inscribed polygons in a circle and kept doubling their sides, up to 192 sides, which gave about 3.14; he later pushed further toward 3.1416. He also worked with negative numbers and an early form of Gaussian elimination, and added a chapter on measuring distant heights and distances, later published as the Sea Island Mathematical Manual.
story_zh: 《九章算术》是汉代编成的数学书，收录246道实际问题，从丈量田亩到分摊赋税，只给出算法和答案，很少说明道理。
263年，生平几乎无从考证的刘徽为它作注，补充了证明和推理。为了求圆周率，他在圆内作正多边形，不断倍增边数，直到192边，得出约3.14，之后又进一步推算到接近3.1416。这就是“割圆术”。他还系统运用负数和类似高斯消元的方程解法，并另撰一卷测量远处高度和距离的方法，后来单独成书，称《海岛算经》。
liu-hui.why: His work made Chinese mathematics a reasoned science and laid the ground for Zu Chongzhi's even more precise value of pi.
liu-hui.why_zh: 刘徽让中国数学有了严密的论证，也为后来祖冲之更精确地计算圆周率打下了基础。

story: After his defeat at Yiling, Liu Bei did not return to Chengdu. He stayed at Baidicheng, a fortress at the head of the Yangtze gorges, where he fell seriously ill. In 223 he summoned Zhuge Liang from Chengdu.

According to the Records of the Three Kingdoms, he told Zhuge that his talent was ten times Cao Pi's. If his son Liu Shan proved worth helping, Zhuge should help him; if not, Zhuge could take the throne himself. Zhuge wept and swore to serve the boy until death. Liu Bei told Liu Shan to treat the chancellor like a father, and died soon after. Zhuge Liang then ran the state of Shu for eleven years and never claimed the throne.
story_zh: 夷陵战败后，刘备没有回成都，而是留在长江三峡口的白帝城，一病不起。223年，他把诸葛亮从成都召来。
据《三国志》记载，刘备对诸葛亮说：你的才能十倍于曹丕；如果太子值得辅佐，就辅佐他；如果他不成器，你可以自己取而代之。诸葛亮流泪发誓，要竭尽全力辅佐太子，至死不渝。刘备又嘱咐刘禅要像对待父亲一样对待丞相，不久去世。此后十一年，诸葛亮主持蜀汉国政，始终没有篡位。
baidi-entrust.why: The scene became the classic image of trust between ruler and minister in Chinese culture.
baidi-entrust.why_zh: 白帝城托孤成为中国文化中君臣相知的经典场景。

story: By 227 Zhuge Liang had restored peace with Wu and secured the south. He was ready to lead the army north to Hanzhong to start the war against Wei. Before leaving, he sent the twenty-year-old emperor Liu Shan a memorial.

In it he reminded the emperor that Shu was weak and the times were dangerous. He urged him to listen to good advice, to reward and punish fairly, and to rely on honest ministers he named. He recalled how Liu Bei had visited him three times in his cottage and how he had served ever since out of gratitude. The memorial is short, plain and deeply personal, and Zhuge says he weeps as he writes it.
story_zh: 到227年，诸葛亮已经与东吴恢复同盟，又平定了南中，准备率军北驻汉中，讨伐曹魏。出发前，他给二十岁的后主刘禅上了一道表章。
他在表中提醒后主，蜀汉国力疲弱，正处在危急存亡之秋；劝他广开言路，赏罚公平，亲近他推荐的几位贤臣。他回忆刘备三顾茅庐的知遇之恩，说自己从此一心报效。全文简短质朴，情真意切，结尾说自己“临表涕零，不知所言”。
chu-shi-biao.why: It is one of the most famous pieces of Chinese prose, still taught in schools as a model of loyalty.
chu-shi-biao.why_zh: 《出师表》是中国最著名的散文之一，至今仍是中学课文，被视为忠臣的典范之作。

quote.zh: 亲贤臣，远小人，此先汉所以兴隆也
quote.en: Staying close to worthy ministers and far from petty men: this is why the Former Han flourished.

story: In the spring of 228 Zhuge Liang's first northern campaign went well. Three commanderies west of the Wei valley went over to Shu, and Wei was caught by surprise. Zhuge needed to hold Jieting, a road junction, to block Wei reinforcements.

He gave the command to Ma Su, a clever officer he trusted, rather than to veteran generals. Ma Su ignored his instructions and the advice of his deputy Wang Ping, and camped on a hill away from water. The Wei general Zhang He surrounded the hill, cut off the water supply and routed the starving army. Zhuge had to retreat and give up his gains. He had Ma Su executed and demoted himself.
story_zh: 228年春，诸葛亮第一次北伐开局顺利，渭水以西的三个郡归降蜀汉，魏国措手不及。诸葛亮必须守住交通要道街亭，阻挡魏国援军。
他没有用老将，而是让自己器重的马谡领兵。马谡违背诸葛亮的部署，也不听副将王平劝告，舍弃水源，在山上扎营。魏将张郃包围山头，切断水源，蜀军饥渴难耐，被一举击溃。诸葛亮只得全军撤退，放弃已得的郡县。他挥泪斩马谡，并上表自贬三级。
jieting.why: It cost Shu its best chance in the northern campaigns and gave rise to the saying "weeping, he executed Ma Su."
jieting.why_zh: 街亭失守使蜀汉错失北伐的最好时机，也留下了“挥泪斩马谡”的典故。

story: The Gongsun family had ruled Liaodong in the northeast since the late Han, nominally loyal but in practice independent. In 237 Gongsun Yuan declared himself King of Yan and beat off a Wei army.

In 238 Emperor Ming sent Sima Yi with 40,000 men. Sima predicted the campaign would take a year. He crossed the Liao River, feinted at the enemy line and marched on Gongsun's capital at Xiangping. Heavy rains flooded the camp, but he refused to retreat. When the rain stopped, he surrounded the city and bombarded it until the food ran out. Gongsun Yuan fled and was killed, and Sima massacred thousands of men in the city.
story_zh: 东汉末年以来，公孙氏一直统治辽东，名义上臣服中原，实际上自成一国。237年，公孙渊自立为燕王，并击退了魏军。
238年，魏明帝派司马懿率四万人出征。司马懿预计往返用时一年。他渡过辽河，佯攻敌军防线，直取公孙渊的都城襄平。大雨使营地积水，他仍坚持不退。雨停后，魏军四面围城，昼夜猛攻，直到城中粮尽。公孙渊突围被杀，司马懿在城中屠杀了数千人。
liaodong-campaign.why: Wei gained the northeast and the Korean commanderies, opening contact with Japan, and Sima Yi's prestige grew sharply.
liaodong-campaign.why_zh: 魏国由此控制东北和朝鲜半岛诸郡，打开了与日本交往的通道，司马懿的威望也大为提高。

story: Goguryeo was a kingdom in the mountains of today's northeast China and northern Korea. It had helped Wei against the Gongsun family, but in 242 King Dongcheon raided a Wei fort near the Yalu River.

In 244 the Wei governor of You Province, Guanqiu Jian, led an army against him. He defeated the Goguryeo forces in battle and captured and sacked the capital at Hwando. The next year his officer Wang Qi chased the fleeing king far to the northeast, into the lands of the Okjeo people. Guanqiu Jian carved a stone to record the victory; a fragment of it was found near Ji'an in 1906. Goguryeo recovered within a few decades.
story_zh: 高句丽是位于今中国东北和朝鲜半岛北部山区的王国，曾协助魏国攻打公孙氏，但242年东川王袭击了鸭绿江附近的魏国据点。
244年，魏幽州刺史毌丘俭率军讨伐，击败高句丽军队，攻破并洗劫了都城丸都。次年，他的部将王颀追击逃亡的高句丽王，一直深入东北的沃沮地区。毌丘俭刻石记功，1906年在集安附近发现了这块残碑。高句丽在几十年内便恢复了元气。
wei-goguryeo.why: It was the farthest Chinese armies had reached into the northeast, though it did not end Goguryeo.
wei-goguryeo.why_zh: 这是当时中原军队深入东北最远的一次，但并未消灭高句丽。

story: Cao Mao became emperor of Wei in 254 at thirteen, after Sima Shi deposed the previous emperor. He was bright and studious, and he resented the Sima family. By 260 Sima Shi's brother Sima Zhao held all real power.

One day Cao Mao told his ministers that he could no longer bear it and would go out and fight Sima Zhao himself. Some ministers ran to warn Sima. The young emperor rode out of the palace with a few hundred guards and servants. Sima's officer Jia Chong met him and ordered the soldier Cheng Ji to act. Cheng stabbed the emperor to death. Sima Zhao later executed Cheng Ji to shift the blame.
story_zh: 254年，司马师废黜前任皇帝，年仅十三岁的曹髦被立为魏帝。他聪明好学，对司马氏专权十分不满。到260年，司马师之弟司马昭已经独揽大权。
一天，曹髦对大臣说，自己再也不能坐等被废，要亲自讨伐司马昭。有大臣立即跑去向司马昭告密。年轻的皇帝带着几百名宿卫和僮仆冲出宫门，司马昭的亲信贾充率兵迎击，指使士兵成济动手，成济当场刺死了曹髦。事后司马昭杀了成济一族推卸罪责。
cao-mao.why: A reigning emperor was killed openly in the street, showing that the Wei throne was now an empty shell.
cao-mao.why_zh: 皇帝当街被杀，说明曹魏皇权已名存实亡。

quote.zh: 司马昭之心，路人所知也
quote.en: Sima Zhao's intentions are known to every passer-by in the street.
quote.from: Han Jin Chunqiu, cited in Records of the Three Kingdoms 汉晋春秋（三国志注引）

story: After Shu surrendered in late 263, Zhong Hui, the Wei commander, had a large army in Sichuan. He accused his rival Deng Ai of plotting rebellion and had him arrested. The Shu general Jiang Wei, who had surrendered to Zhong, secretly encouraged Zhong to break away from Wei, hoping to restore Shu.

In early 264 Zhong Hui locked up his senior officers in Chengdu and prepared to declare independence. Rumors spread among the soldiers that Zhong planned to kill all the northern officers. The troops rose, stormed the palace and killed Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei. In the chaos Deng Ai was also killed by men sent after him. Wei lost three of its leading generals in a few days.
story_zh: 263年底蜀汉投降后，魏军统帅钟会手握重兵留驻蜀地。他诬告对手邓艾谋反，将其逮捕。已投降钟会的蜀将姜维暗中怂恿他脱离魏国自立，企图借机复兴蜀汉。
264年初，钟会在成都软禁魏军众将，准备举兵自立。军中传言钟会要杀尽北方将士，士兵们发动兵变，攻入宫中，杀死钟会和姜维。混乱中，邓艾也被追来的人所杀。短短几天内，魏国折损了三员大将。
zhong-hui-revolt.why: It ended the last hopes of restoring Shu and removed the generals who might have challenged Sima Zhao.
zhong-hui-revolt.why_zh: 复兴蜀汉的最后希望就此破灭，可能威胁司马昭的将领也被一并清除。
